About

Shilpa Medicare Incorporated in 1987 manufactures niche APIs, intermediates, and formulations and also undertakes contract research and manufacturing service for some of its customers. The company’s formulation products consist of 16 injectable dosage forms, 19 oral solid dosage forms under SML and 13 formulations under SML’s wholly owned subsidiary Shilpa Therapeutics.[1]

Key Points

Business Verticals [1] [2]
a) Active Pharma Ingredients (50% in FY26 vs 57% in FY25):[3]
The company conducts its API business through its WOS Shilpa Pharma Lifesciences, which manufactures oncology and non-oncology APIs, intermediates, payloads and linkers, peptides, and bio-polymers. The subsidiary also offers Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
Revenue Mix:[4]
Oncology: 46% in FY26 vs 44% in FY25
Non-Oncology: 40% in FY26 vs 38% in FY25
Specialty CDMO: 11% in FY26 vs 15% in FY25
Others: 3% in FY26 vs 35 in FY25
